Cynthia eats one serving of ice cream each night. Over 60 days, she will eat a total of 60 servings. Each carton contains 15 servings. The number of cartons she needs is \(60 \div 15 = 4\) cartons. Each carton costs $4.00, so her total spending is \(4 \times \$4.00 = \$16.00\).

Answer: $16.00
